caption: The drawing features a repeating pattern composed primarily of birds, branches, and various flowers, rendered in red ink on a cream or light tan background. The main section, occupying the upper central portion of the paper, displays multiple birds perched on or flying around intertwining branches covered with detailed flowers and foliage. Among the birds, some are more prominent and larger, with elongated tails, while smaller birds are distributed throughout the pattern. The floral elements vary in size and type, with densely packed blossoms, leaves, and buds filling the space between the branches and birds, creating an intricate, non-uniform lattice. In the lower left of the image, there is a separate, smaller rectangular section containing a close-up of a single large, elaborate flower on a branch, accompanied by a smaller bee-like insect nearby. Both the primary pattern and the inset detail are rendered in the same red linework style, with no other colors present. The entire composition is centered on a larger sheet, with broad, empty margins surrounding the illustrated areas.
title: Bed Curtain
